paraphrase: For every relation R and source predicate: if every being's power is inductively grounded in an intrinsic source (FinitelyGroundedPower), no source receives an R-link, and each being has at most one immediate R-cause, then every being is R-accessible (the corpus's reading of the per se regress premise). A conditional relating these conditions; it asserts none of them of any actual causal relation.
